metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a micro_skill (asset_level 3) with identical semantic capability to existing session_skill (asset_level 2) 'Install Third-Party JAR to Local Repository'. Both describe the same workflow: identifying JAR metadata, executing mvn install:install-file, verifying local repository placement, and declaring dependencies. The candidate provides more granular micro-level detail but does not introduce a distinct capability—it is a narrower, more detailed view of the same operation. Merging into the session_skill preserves the broader workflow context while the micro_skill can be deprecated or consolidated.
